title: sslabdata projects file
description: The file lab.yaml names as projects_file: a list of research projects, one record each. It describes what sslabdata's loader accepts; the loader stays the authority, and reports each problem under a code in SPEC.md, Diagnostic codes. A record key not listed here is reported as RECORD-KEY-UNKNOWN and ignored, so it is allowed. What each field becomes in the document is in SPEC.md §5. Published input schemas are immutable: this one is served from the input-schema-v2 tag, which is created when this version ships and is never moved (SPEC.md §6).

id.description: The project's id, unique in the file (PROJECTS-ID-DUPLICATE). A work's project field names it.

image.description: A URL or a site path, carried as plain text.
